# 沙彌尼離戒文

**ID:** T1475
**Volume:** T24
**Category:** 律部類
**Original Category:** 律部
**Byline:** 失譯
**Date:** 317–420
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T1475

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle anonymous compilation of the ten precepts for *śrāmaṇerī* 沙彌尼 (novice nuns), framed as a recitation-text. Translator and date unknown.

**Abstract**

The *Shāmínī líjiè wén* presents the *śrāmaṇerī* precepts in continuous recitation-format, similar in function to a *prātimokṣa* but for the novice rank. The title 離戒 *líjiè* "liberation precepts" reflects the Pāli *vimutti-sīla* concept — the ten precepts as conducive to liberation. Together with [KR6k0063](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0063) this text supplied the practical Vinaya for the early-medieval Chinese *śrāmaṇerī*-saṅgha.
